first-time-talking.npc: Adventurer. The General warned us about you.
Yes. He said you might show up here again. We're not to harm you, but make no mistake, we're keeping a close eye on you. You're not to be trusted.

first-time-talking.player: Well I guess that's the best I can hope for. So how are things going here?

first-time-talking.npc: We are not here to make small talk. Leave us to our work.

standard-dialogue-before-completing-dese.npc: You again? As I told you before, we are not here to make small talk. Leave us to our work.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-deser.npc: I already told you to stop bothering us. Please go away.
